data.text: Timing with documentation, 10 000 events + 60 docs × 4 revisions of 8 KiB (~2 MB of text) vs the same journal without: prime cold 542 vs 521 ms, warm 353 vs 338 ms, doc list 360 vs 348 ms — about +4%. Absolute numbers are from a loaded machine (load 8.5, bare node start 110 ms) and are not the budget; the in-process guardrail test/perf.test.ts passes. Re-measure on a quiet machine before release.
